title: Supply 'N Destroy
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Hunt & Destroy

Quest Description: Slay the Fizz Master and destroy 30 Barrels of O'Fizz

Quest Reward: 5000 Gold and 1 Kings Coins

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Destroy 30 Barrels O' Fizz and Kill Vergrim's Fizzmaster and Return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

Competition really brings out the worst in me... so I need you to get rid of the competition for me, Dungeon Runner. Vergrim has a Fizz Plant and Supply Department in Vergrim's Vexation off of level 5 and I need you to go in and cause some havoc. Once you get into the Plant take out Vergrim's Fizzmaster. The Fizzmaster is responsibe for brewing all of Vergrim's Fizzerator energy drinks so killing that creature will destroy their ability to make more Fizzerator. Then, once you get into the Supply Department I need you to destroy the majority of the Barrels O' Fizz so that their ability to supply the demand for Vergrim's Fizzerator is completely disabled. That should open the door for me to really start raking in the gold!

Just so we're clear, Dungeon Runner, here is the plan. The Fizz Plant and Supply Department are located in Vergrim's Vexation off of level 5. Once you are in the Fizz Plant find and kill the Fizzmaster. Then go into the Supply Department and destroy 30 Barrels O' Fizz. Sounds easy right? Well, prove it! Once you have finished those tasks return to me, Audrey the Alchemist, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

Who needs friends, cats, or a hubby when I have a Dungeon Runner like you!!! Here is your reward! Now I can concentrate on getting to work on this new energy drink! I think I may call it the Fizzing Audrey... Yeah, I like that!

Objectives:

  • Slay the Fizzmaster
  • Destroyed Barrels O' Fizz

Client level range: 20–30
